Lazada Asset management uses Axioma for quantitive risk analytics: https://qontigo.com/

Lazada Asset management first uses Python to do research and then Java for production level implementation. 
Python libraries: pandas/numpy, seaborn, jupyter notebooks

Elevation securities is a equity research company. The way they make money is by identifying important and relevant information for investors

- Timeliness is key
- information is submitted in the form of a report
- call companies to talk to CEO
- follow on Laws to figure out its impact on companies

Password: 4byRd*wJ

People in the finance industry (hedge funds) does not pay to buy trading signals. Instead they pay for the ability to talk to you for an hour to ask you questions about an area you are focused on.

Its more like a consulting kind of service. The clients (hedge funds) determine their own call and make the trade

There are no people in the industry that sell or buy trading signals. It is the job of hedge fund managers to generate the buy and sell signal and not to buy it

Password: 4byRd*wJ

Follows people on Twitter who does research analysis he finds valuable. Doesn't need to know what their price target is. But knowing if the folks he is following is bullish or bearish on a company helps him identify blindspots in his own mental model about the company

Source of insights

- Looking for differentiated view points
- Looking for consensus
- Check if source is looking at more fundamental data (closer to the operating side of the business) than himself
- Checking based on actual ground truth if forward guidance is actually achievable

Password: 4byRd*wJ

Gamification: corner case the signal however accurate must be actionable. 

- No point submitting a signal for a price to be up over the next few seconds if the market is still closed for the next 6 hours!!
- some stocks don't move, you can make a prediction that the price will stay the same and you will be correct

Bloomberg has a feature that rates analysts for the accuracy of their research versus the market. Almost all of them have a negative score but on one cares. Hedge funds are engaging them because of their expertise in very specific industrial areas

Password: 4byRd*wJ

Hedge funds don't want people following them. Sell side wants more followers because that is how they make money. You want people to call you to get your information. You don't want to give away your stuff for free

Password: 4byRd*wJ

Proposed to take all the calls of people on twitter and build a portfolio tracker using it. The goal is to determine 

- the drawdown is on the portfolio calls
- how volatile the portfolio is
- benchmark against the market
- the Sharpe ratio is very important
- the trading calls need to be executable

narrative.text: Ilya Voytov contributed to the TrueSight DAO from late 2018 through mid-2022, with 14 contributions primarily in the Build Game - Strategy category. He focused on submitting reference material and links (8 contributions), reviewing proposed strategies with specific improvements (1), suggesting cautions or areas to watch out for (1), and independently reiterating pending decision signals (1). His work supported strategic development in the DAO's initiatives around Agroverse, Sun Mint, and related ventures.
